g.title: installer
g.text: (new): on save, on membership change, and a primary-gated reconciler
1 discover clusters: install namespace + namespaces labeled
2 per cluster: groups naming it, plus every-cluster groups
3 expand Who into account names (each member's account in that project)
4 percent → rate using that cluster's thread count
5 USER SET / ALTER / DROP per group; USER ALIAS SET / DROP per account
6 write the state row per (group, cluster)
